name: Khayre Ali
title: Khayre Ali | Evaluations at General Intuition
description: Khayre Ali lives in New York City and works on the evaluations team at General Intuition. He is pursuing a master's in computer science at Northeastern.
introduction:
Hi, I'm Khayre. I grew up in Dubai, and I started programming at The Hill School in Pennsylvania, out of genuine curiosity. It stuck. I studied business at NYU Stern, and after graduating, worked in IT audit for clients like IBM and Kyndryl. That role pulled me deeper into the tech ecosystem.
I now live in New York City and work on the evaluations team at General Intuition. I'm also pursuing a Master's in Computer Science at Northeastern.
When I'm not studying, I'm probably spending time with my friends and family. Coding has become a hobby too, which I'm told is a good sign. Feel free to reach out to me on LinkedIn.
